subject: Addendum: speaking timebank & LED banner placement — Orchid Summit
body:
---Message 1---
From: Elena Torres <elena@orchidsummit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Hollis <mark.h@venueops.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid Summit sponsorship addendum / LED banner placement and speaking timebank

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for committing to the Orchid Summit mainstage package. A few follow-ups from ops as we finalize the addendum:

- We need confirmation on the LED banner placement — two 3m x 1.5m housings behind the demo wall or the side-of-stage truss. See attached spec for sightlines.
- The organizer team has set aside a 10-minute speaking timebank for Redwood; you previously asked if that could be split into two 5-minute segments. Ops wants written confirmation so we can reserve the running order slots.
- AV load-in: early access requested at 07:00 on the morning of 21 June for banner rigging and mic checks. Venue requires an AV sign-off form (attached).

I’ve attached the draft addendum (Orchid_Sponsor_Addendum_v2.pdf) and the LED spec. If you approve, we’ll send the DocuSign link for signature and confirm placement on the site plan.

Can you confirm by EOD Wed (12 May)?

Best,
Elena Torres
Partnerships Lead, Orchid Summit
[Attachment: Orchid_Sponsor_Addendum_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Orchid_LED_spec.pdf (pdf)]

---Message 2---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@orchidsummit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mark Hollis <mark.h@venueops.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid Summit sponsorship addendum / LED banner placement and speaking timebank

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the clear summary — a couple points from our side before we sign:

1) LED banner placement: side-of-stage truss is our preference for camera visibility, but we need assurance it won’t obscure the sponsor logo wall for photos. Can you confirm the truss is at least 4m from center stage? If not, we’ll take the demo-wall placement.

2) Speaking timebank: we’d like to split the 10 minutes into 6 + 4 (one keynote moment + short product plug in a panel). Is that possible? If a split isn’t workable, we’ll accept a single 10-minute slot but ask for a runway in the program notes to include a product demo link.

3) AV load-in: 07:00 is fine, but can the venue provide a stagehand for rigging? If not, we’ll bring our crew and need clearance for scissor lift use — please confirm site lift policy and any insurance requirements.

I’m looping Kimberly (events ops) to confirm logistics and Aditya for sponsorship billing/credits.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

---Message 3---
From: Elena Torres <elena@orchidsummit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Hollis <mark.h@venueops.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid Summit sponsorship addendum / LED banner placement and speaking timebank

Hi Mina — great, answers below:

1) Truss distance: confirmed. The side truss position is 4.2m from center stage (see site plan link in Drive). It will not block the photo wall; we can add a 1.0m offset if you want extra clearance.

2) Speaking split: we can do 6 + 4. We’ll draft the running order to reflect a 6-minute mainstage segment and a 4-minute insertion during the ‘Data & Infrastructure’ panel (afternoon session). We’ll also include a program note with your demo link.

3) Stagehand / scissor lift: venue provides two stagehands for sponsor rigging between 06:30–08:30. Scissor lift use requires a certificate of insurance (COI) listing the venue as additional insured. I’ve asked Mark to confirm the venue’s minimum coverage.

I’ll update the addendum and send a DocuSign link once Mark confirms the insurance language.

Best,
Elena

---Message 4---
From: Mark Hollis <mark.h@venueops.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena@orchidsummit.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid Summit sponsorship addendum / LED banner placement and speaking timebank

Mina — quick note from venue ops:

- COI: venue requires general liability at $2M and a separate vendor liability endorsement for aerial equipment (scissor lifts). Please have your vendor/installer name "Orchard Event Center" as additional insured.
- Stagehand timing confirmed: two crew for two hours during load-in; if you need additional crew, we can arrange at $80/hr per person.
- Rigging approvals: LED rigging must follow the attached rigging rubric; please submit your rigging plan 10 business days before the event.

Attaching the rigging rubric and the vendor COI template.

-Mark
[Attachment: Orchid_Rigging_Rubric.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Vendor_COI_Template.pdf (pdf)]

---Message 5---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@orchidsummit.com>, Mark Hollis <mark.h@venueops.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid Summit sponsorship addendum / LED banner placement and speaking timebank

Thanks — we’re good to proceed with the side truss (4.2m) and the 6 + 4 speaking allocation. A few action items from Redwood:

- Aditya will route a vendor COI to the venue by Fri (21 May) with the required endorsements.
- Kimberly will upload the rigging plan and the LED mount drawings to the Drive folder by next Wednesday (26 May).
- Mina will review the updated addendum and sign once DocuSign is live — please notify when link is sent.

Small ask: given the split in speaking time, can we secure a 30-second pre-roll slide in the mainstage transition loop? That was part of our original package but didn’t appear in v2 of the addendum. If you can add that, we’ll sign immediately.

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth show.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
[Sent from my mobile — brief reply]
